title: Twilio API key secret: benign near miss controls
summary: 1 input holding near-miss values that resemble the format but break it (truncated, wrong separator, wrong prefix or too short).
rationale: Incomplete or malformed values are not issued credentials. They test whether the format's structure, and not only its look, is what identifies a credential.

Malformed-by-construction control: prefix-only, truncated, mis-delimited or public-material shape of a contracted family. Expected silence follows from construction.
